verdict.rationale: Dover documents a first-party Reporting & Analytics section with charts you can save, view full screen, or share, so it has its own analytics capability. The evidence never says which funnel metrics those charts cover. The EEO tab and CSV export are a different metric and a user-side workaround, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented stage-conversion reporting, time-to-hire metrics, source-effectiveness reporting, offer-accept rates, per-role and per-team breakdowns of these metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I see the hiring funnel honestly — stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-accept rates per role and team

citations.quote: Click the three dots on any chart to **Save as PNG**, open a **Full screen view**, or **Share** the chart.
